source.title: NREL H2FillS 2022 HDVS Type IV sample test result
source.publisher: National Renewable Energy Laboratory / National Laboratory of the Rockies

capacity_eos_with_frozen_fit.basis: 9.8 kg divided by tabulated Hydrogen density at 70 MPa and 15 C; frozen H2Protocol fit retained

capacity_eos_no_volume_fit.basis: 9.8 kg divided by tabulated Hydrogen density at 70 MPa and 15 C; effective-volume multiplier fixed at one

interpretation.finding: The frozen legacy geometry has a systematic negative pressure bias; capacity-EOS geometry removes that bias in this post-access diagnostic.
interpretation.claim_boundary: This is a post-access sensitivity diagnostic, not a prospective validation pass and not evidence of station safety or full-loop performance.

next_action: Keep production default and frozen validation protocol unchanged until a new prospective split is defined.
Prepare an independent geometry protocol using capacity, nominal pressure and temperature with no outcome-dependent fitting.
Re-run disjoint tank and station-to-receiving-vessel cohorts before changing the runtime default.
